A coram of Judicial Member Shammi Khan and Technical Member Sanjeev Sharma orally pronounced the decision today. Interim resolution professional (IRP) Ravindra Kumar Goyal filed the withdrawal application under Section 12A read with Section 60(5) of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC), 2016. Section 12A of the IBC allows the party that initiated insolvency proceedings to seek withdrawal of the application after it has been admitted, subject to approval by the committee of creditors (CoC) with 90% voting share and compliance with the prescribed procedure. Section 60(5) of the IBC empowers the NCLT to dispose of any application or proceeding by or against the corporate debtor.
